text: Findings for the present study imply that targeting dissociation symptoms might be of importance to reduce suicide risk in university students. However, therapeutic interventions should also target on reducing avoidance coping and improving other adaptive coping strategies in order to reduce the consequences of maladaptive psychological mechanisms.
source_label: Unravelling associations of personality traits, emotion regulation strategies, coping styles, and psychopathology with suicide risk in university students: a network perspective
